title: Unveiling the adsorptive potential of Populus ciliata leaf powder for methylene blue removal from environmental samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41899-41910
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06607G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Salma Gul, Nadeem Raza, Maria Naseer, Khalid Aziz, Hajera Gul, Aaliya Minhaz, Mohamed Khairy, Abdelmonaim Azzouz
To cope with environmental hazards caused by synthetic dyes, herein, we report an inexpensive biosorbent based on Populus ciliata leaf powder for the adsorption of methylene blue (MB) from aqueous solutions.
